verdict.rationale: The browser-based Editor ships built-in real-time collaboration. Multiple developers, artists and designers can build the same scene simultaneously with 'no merge conflicts', and Checkpoints provide project snapshots and rollback. Scripts can be edited locally via the VS Code extension or synced with playcanvas-sync, and engine-only Vite/TypeScript projects are plain code. Community users have complained about not being able to use their own source control, which narrows the git story but does not contradict the documented collaboration features. Missing for 10: evidence of diffable/mergeable text scene formats or git-based branching for Editor scenes, and independent hands-on corroboration of the collaboration workflow.
